goal: Die I129-Persistenzgrenze in isolierte Service-, Recovery- und Integritäts-Laboriterationen I135–I140 zerlegen, ohne einen produktiven Save-, HTTP- oder Browser-Write-Pfad zu öffnen.

guide_delta.summary: I134 zerlegt die geplante Persistenz in sechs kleine Laboriterationen: Kandidat/Preview, Commit-Orchestrator, Recovery-Snapshot, Restore-Simulation, Read-back-Integrität und TOCTOU/Crash-Matrix. Eine separate spätere Release-Iteration bleibt Pflicht.

direct_dependencies: I132 defaultSelection browser slice is merged and green
I133 duplicate browser structure slice is merged and green
I129 defines the parent Preview/Integrity/Recovery boundary
tests_required: Step 1: validate that I135-I140 have explicit dependencies, lab boundaries, negative tests and exit gates
Step 1: each lab must explicitly exclude productive HTTP/browser writes
Step 1: final release must remain a separate future iteration
Step 2 after green: link I129 to I134 and synchronize README/TODO planning status
Step 2: product checkbox count must remain exactly 21 of 132
tests_explicitly_not_run: browser tests because I134 changes no UI/runtime
store tests because I134 changes no store implementation
database tests because no schema or SQLite path changes
Control Plane behavior tests because governance implementation is unchanged
risks: a lab plan could accidentally be read as product-Save authorization
recovery and integrity concerns must stay independently gateable
combining crash/concurrency work too early would make failures hard to localize
expected_side_effects: I129 becomes executable as six isolated future lab iterations
service, recovery and integrity risks can be validated independently
productive Save remains behind a separate release gate
